title: Returned Funding and the Restoration Reserve Percentage (Paystride Payroll Card Program)
content:
**Rule.** For a Paystride Payroll Card Program, the restoration reserve percentage — the percent of the restoration batch basis held as the restoration reserve when a restoring payment is worked out — follows the funding returns booked on the program in the restoration look-back: with two or more such returns it is the package's reserve percent plus 10 points, with exactly one it is the package's reserve percent plus 5 points, and with no funding return in the look-back no points are added.

**Zero-percent packages.** A package whose reserve percent is zero holds a restoration reserve only through the points a returned funding payment adds to the restoration reserve percentage; outside a restoring payment the reserve rule still reads: Packages with a zero reserve percentage hold no reserve.

**The look-back.** The restoration look-back holds the funding entries dated today or earlier that lie fewer than three whole months before today, the whole months between two dates being the difference in calendar months less one when the later date's day of the month is smaller than the earlier date's. A funding return counts by its entry date.

### Percentage by package and returns in the look-back

| Package | Reserve percent of the package | Exactly one return | Two or more returns |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 10 | 15 | 20 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 10 | 15 | 20 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 5 | 10 | 15 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 5 | 10 | 15 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 0 | 5 | 10 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 0 | 5 | 10 |

With no funding return in the look-back no points are added.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical, today being 20 August, a Premier package program)

- One funding return dated 21 May (2 whole months before today) is in the look-back: the percentage is 5.
- A second return dated 20 May (3 whole months before today) is outside it, so the count stays at one and the percentage stays 5.
- No return in the look-back: no points are added, and with the Premier percent of zero the restoration reserve comes to nothing.
